## Resumo
A trust-first cookie consent / privacy-preferences modal presented as the live hero centerpiece of a product page for the placeholder brand 'ModalDesign' (a modal-state component kit). On a deep-navy aurora field (radial amber + blue washes over #081933 with a faint masked grid), a sticky frosted nav sits over a two-column hero where THE consent dialog is the moment: a max-w-[560px] rounded-2xl 'ticket' card (a vertical navy gradient #0e2748 -> #081933) with a header (cookie title + close), an amber divider, an honest two-sentence privacy message with a 'Read our policy' link, three category rows (Strictly necessary locked-on, Analytics + Marketing pill toggles defaulting off), and a balanced footer (Accept all / Reject all + a bordered Save preferences). Below: a full-bleed navy-850 'patterns' band with a 4-up card grid (Consent / Confirm / Auth / Notice), a two-column 'anatomy' band pairing a numbered 4-zone breakdown with a mini callout dialog, a 3-up 'why it works' trust band (no dark patterns / contrast that passes / folds never breaks), a prompt-ready CTA band with a faux prompt.txt code card, and a footer. The system is cream-on-navy with a single reserved amber #f0b429 accent. Built entirely on Inter (400-900), Phosphor icons via Iconify.

## Estilo Visual
Use a calm, trustworthy dark design system. Body background navy-900 #081933. Build an 'aurora' hero/CTA backdrop from layered radials: radial-gradient(820px 520px at 78% -8%, rgba(240,180,41,0.16), transparent 60%) + radial-gradient(900px 640px at 8% 18%, rgba(42,90,166,0.30), transparent 62%) + radial-gradient(1100px 800px at 50% 120%, rgba(22,53,98,0.40), transparent 60%), with a faint cream grid overlay (two 1px linear-gradients of rgba(240,236,216,0.035) at 64px spacing) masked by radial-gradient(circle at 50% 30%, #000 0%, transparent 78%). EXACT palette tokens — navy: 900 #081933, 850 #0b1f3a, 800 #0e2748, 700 #163562, 600 #1f4684, 500 #2a5aa6; cream: DEFAULT #f4ecd8, soft #e8dec6, dim #c8bfa6; amber: DEFAULT #f0b429, 600 #d99a12, 300 #f7cf6b. Discipline rule: cream tones carry ALL text (cream for headings/strong, cream-dim #c8bfa6 for body/muted, cream-soft #e8dec6 for the prompt code), and amber #f0b429 is RESERVED for accents only — the brand mark, primary CTA fill (amber bg + navy-900 text), the locked-on/active toggle, eyebrow chips, the header divider glow, and link text (amber-300 #f7cf6b). Selection: background #f0b429, color #081933. Fonts: Inter via Google Fonts (weights 400/500/600/700/800/900) as the only family. Radii: rounded-lg/xl on tiles + buttons, rounded-2xl on cards + the dialog. Shadows: shadow-dialog = 0 40px 90px -20px rgba(3,10,24,0.75), 0 0 0 1px rgba(240,180,41,0.10) (a deep lift + a hairline amber ring); shadow-pill = 0 14px 30px -12px rgba(240,180,41,0.55) (an amber glow under the primary CTA and brand tile). Buttons: btn-amber = bg #f0b429 + #081933 text, hover bg #f7cf6b; btn-ghost = bg rgba(244,236,216,0.04) + cream text + inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(240,236,216,0.16) ring, hover inset amber/45 ring. The dialog card is a '.ticket' = linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(14,39,72,0.9), rgba(8,25,51,0.9)) with a border-white/10. Motion: a .fade-up keyframe (opacity 0 + translateY(16px) -> 1/0 over .7s) on hero columns, plus smooth transitions on toggles (.25s) and card hovers (.2s). Icons are Phosphor via Iconify, amber on navy.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky frosted nav

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Componente
The signature component: a `role="dialog" aria-modal="true"` `.ticket max-w-[560px] rounded-2xl border border-white/10 shadow-dialog` card presented as the live hero centerpiece (floated on a soft `absolute -inset-3 bg-amber/10 blur-2xl` glow, not on a blank artboard). It maps to four zones: a header (amber cookie title + bordered close button) over an amber gradient divider; an honest two-sentence message with a 'Read our policy' amber-300 link; a stack of three category rows (necessary locked-on, analytics + marketing toggles defaulting off); and a balanced footer where Accept all (amber) and Reject all (ghost) share equal weight on the left while a bordered Save preferences anchors the right. The whole component is the anti-dark-pattern thesis: amber is reserved, reject is as easy as accept, and cream-on-navy keeps it legible.

### Componente
A 58x32px rounded-full pill switch with a 24px knob (top:4px) that slides via a .25s cubic-bezier transition, in three states: `.toggle-locked` (track #2a3f64 + inset amber/35 ring, knob at left:30px in amber #f0b429 holding a navy-900 ph:check-bold) for the always-on 'Strictly necessary' row; `.toggle-on` (track amber #f0b429 + inset amber/60 ring, knob at left:30px in navy-900 #081933 holding a navy-900 ph:check-bold) for an active category; `.toggle-off` (track #1c2f50 + inset cream/12 ring, knob at left:4px in cream #f4ecd8 holding a navy-700 ph:x-bold) for an opted-out category. Each carries role="switch" + aria-checked (or aria-label='Always on' for the locked variant).

### Componente
A `.cat-row flex items-center gap-4 rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-navy-800/60 px-4 py-3.5` row (hover border-amber/35 + bg rgba(20,42,80,0.65)) used three-up inside the dialog body. Layout: a 28px (h-7 w-7) rounded-full bg-white/5 expander button with a cream-dim `.chev` ph:caret-down-bold (14px) on the left, a min-w-0 flex-1 column with a 14.5px font-bold cream title + a 12px cream-dim description, and a flex-none pill toggle on the right. Rows: 'Strictly necessary' (locked-on, 'Sessions, security, load balancing. Always active.'), 'Analytics' (off, 'Anonymous usage to help us improve the canvas.'), 'Marketing' (off, 'Personalized offers and remarketing pixels.').

### Componente
The atmospheric backdrop reused on the hero and CTA bands: `.aurora` = three layered radials (radial-gradient(820px 520px at 78% -8%, rgba(240,180,41,0.16), transparent 60%) amber top-right, radial-gradient(900px 640px at 8% 18%, rgba(42,90,166,0.30), transparent 62%) blue upper-left, radial-gradient(1100px 800px at 50% 120%, rgba(22,53,98,0.40), transparent 60%) navy bottom) over the navy-900 body. Over it, `.grid-faint` = two 1px linear-gradients of rgba(240,236,216,0.035) at background-size 64px 64px, masked by radial-gradient(circle at 50% 30%, #000 0%, transparent 78%) so the grid fades to nothing at the edges. The amber-tinted glow `absolute -inset-3 rounded-[28px] bg-amber/10 blur-2xl` sits behind the dialog.

### Componente
A faux terminal card in the CTA band: an `mx-auto max-w-2xl rounded-2xl border border-white/12 bg-navy-900/70 p-1.5 shadow-dialog backdrop-blur` wrapper with a top bar (border-b border-white/10 px-4 py-2.5) showing an amber ph:terminal-window-fill + a 12px font-semibold cream-dim 'prompt.txt' label on the left and an amber Copy pill (rounded-md bg-amber px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-bold text-navy-900 + ph:copy-fill) on the right, over a `px-4 py-4 font-mono text-[13px] leading-relaxed text-cream-soft` paragraph that states the generate prompt and highlights the navy #0b1f3a + amber #f0b429 hexes inline in amber-300.

## Notas Especiais
Single Google Font: Inter (weights 400/500/600/700/800/900) as the only family (font-sans) — headlines extrabold/black (800-900) with tight tracking, body in cream-dim. Icons are Phosphor via Iconify (ph:shield-check-fill, ph:cookie-fill, ph:x-bold, ph:check-bold, ph:caret-down-bold, ph:magic-wand-fill, ph:check-circle-fill, ph:warning-circle-fill, ph:sign-in-fill, ph:bell-ringing-fill, ph:scales-fill, ph:eye-fill, ph:device-mobile-fill, ph:terminal-window-fill, ph:copy-fill, ph:rocket-launch-fill). EXACT tokens — navy 900 #081933, 850 #0b1f3a, 800 #0e2748, 700 #163562, 600 #1f4684, 500 #2a5aa6; cream DEFAULT #f4ecd8, soft #e8dec6, dim #c8bfa6; amber DEFAULT #f0b429, 600 #d99a12, 300 #f7cf6b. THE CORE DISCIPLINE (the point of this item): amber is RESERVED — it appears only on the brand mark, the primary CTA, the locked-on/active toggle, eyebrow chips, the header divider glow, and link text — so it always reads as a real, reversible choice and never as a manipulative default; cream-on-navy carries all text at WCAG-AA contrast; and Accept all / Reject all get equal weight (anti-dark-pattern). Radii: rounded-lg/xl on tiles + buttons, rounded-2xl on cards + the dialog. Shadows: shadow-dialog 0 40px 90px -20px rgba(3,10,24,0.75) + 0 0 0 1px rgba(240,180,41,0.10); shadow-pill 0 14px 30px -12px rgba(240,180,41,0.55). Effects: the layered .aurora hero/CTA backdrop + a masked .grid-faint overlay; an amber/10 blur glow behind the dialog; a frosted sticky nav (navy-900/80 + backdrop-blur-xl). Toggle states: .toggle-locked (#2a3f64 track, amber knob right), .toggle-on (amber track, navy knob right), .toggle-off (#1c2f50 track, cream knob left), each a 58x32 pill with a .25s knob slide. Motion: a .fade-up keyframe on hero columns (opacity 0 + translateY(16px) -> 1/0 over .7s), smooth .2-.25s transitions on toggles + .cat-row + card hovers. Layout: a sticky top-0 z-50 frosted nav over full-bleed bands on a shared max-w-6xl mx-auto px-5 sm:px-8 container (aurora two-column hero with the dialog centerpiece, navy-850 4-up patterns band, navy-900 anatomy band with a numbered list + mini callout dialog, navy-850 3-up trust band, aurora CTA band with a prompt.txt card, navy-900 footer). Responsive reflow: the hero + anatomy two-column grids collapse to one column, the nav center links hide (md:flex) and 'Copy prompt' hides (sm:block), the patterns grid steps sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 and trust md:grid-cols-3, the dialog footer stacks (sm:flex-row -> column) with Accept/Reject grouped, and the footer goes column. Accessibility intent: role="dialog" aria-modal on the card, role="switch" + aria-checked on the toggles, AA cream-on-navy contrast, and a balanced (non-dark-pattern) footer.

style.description: A calm, trustworthy, premium dark aesthetic engineered for a consent surface: the opposite of a dark pattern. The mood is deep and editorial: an 'aurora' field of layered radial gradients (an amber wash top-right, a blue wash upper-left, a navy wash bottom) over a near-black navy #081933 body, with a very faint cream grid masked to a soft radial vignette so the background has texture without noise. The whole point: amber is scarce so it reads as a real, reversible choice, and cream-on-navy keeps the consent message legible and honest.

Shadows: shadow-dialog = 0 40px 90px -20px rgba(3,10,24,0.75), 0 0 0 1px rgba(240,180,41,0.10) (a deep lift + a hairline amber ring); shadow-pill = 0 14px 30px -12px rgba(240,180,41,0.55) (an amber glow under the primary CTA and brand tile). Buttons: btn-amber = bg #f0b429 + #081933 text, hover bg #f7cf6b; btn-ghost = bg rgba(244,236,216,0.04) + cream text + inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(240,236,216,0.16) ring, hover inset amber/45 ring. The dialog card is a '.ticket' = linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(14,39,72,0.9), rgba(8,25,51,0.9)) with a border-white/10. Motion: a .fade-up keyframe (opacity 0 + translateY(16px) -> 1/0 over .7s) on hero columns, plus smooth transitions on toggles (.25s) and card hovers (.2s). Icons are Phosphor via Iconify, amber on navy.

layout_and_structure.description: A single vertically-scrolling product page built from full-bleed bands on a shared max-w-6xl mx-auto px-5 sm:px-8 container, with the consent modal as the hero centerpiece (live, in context) rather than an overlay on a blank artboard. Order: (1) a sticky top-0 z-50 frosted nav (navy-900/80 + backdrop-blur-xl, border-b border-white/10); (2) an 'aurora' hero with a two-column grid (left copy: eyebrow chip + big two-line headline with the second line amber + lead + two CTAs + a three-item check strip; right: THE consent dialog card floated on a soft amber blur); (3) a full-bleed navy-850 'patterns' band with an intro + a 4-up card grid; (4) an 'anatomy' band (navy-900 + faint grid) with a two-column grid pairing a numbered 4-zone list with a mini callout dialog; (5) a full-bleed navy-850 'why it works' trust band with a 3-up card grid; (6) an 'aurora' prompt/CTA band centered with a faux prompt.txt code card and two CTAs; then a navy-900 footer. It reflows cleanly to mobile: the hero and anatomy grids collapse to one column (lg:grid-cols-[...] -> 1), the nav center links hide (md:flex) and the 'Copy prompt' link hides (sm:block), the patterns grid steps 1 -> 2 -> 4 columns and trust 1 -> 3, the dialog footer buttons stack (sm:flex-row -> column) with Accept/Reject grouped, and the footer goes column.

prompts.prompt: A `<header class="sticky top-0 z-50 border-b border-white/10 bg-navy-900/80 backdrop-blur-xl">` wrapping a `mx-auto flex max-w-6xl items-center justify-between px-5 py-3.5 sm:px-8` row. Left: a brand lockup = a 36px (h-9 w-9) rounded-xl bg-amber tile with shadow-pill holding a navy-900 Phosphor ph:shield-check-fill (20px), beside a 15px font-extrabold tracking-tight wordmark 'Modal' (cream) + 'Design' (amber). Center (hidden below md): four 13.5px font-medium cream-dim links (Patterns, Anatomy, Prompt, Why it works) that hover to cream. Right: a ghost 13.5px font-semibold cream-dim 'Copy prompt' link (hidden below sm) + a primary pill 'Open in canvas' (rounded-lg bg-amber px-4 py-2 text-[13.5px] font-bold text-navy-900 shadow-pill, hover bg-amber-300).

LEFT (`.fade-up max-w-xl`): an eyebrow chip (inline-flex rounded-full border border-amber/30 bg-amber/10 px-3.5 py-1.5 text-[12px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-amber-300 with a ph:cookie-fill icon + 'Consent & Privacy'); an `mt-6 text-[2.6rem] sm:text-[3.4rem] font-extrabold leading-[1.04] tracking-tight text-cream` two-line headline 'Consent that' / a second amber line 'earns the click.'; an `mt-6 text-[1.05rem] leading-relaxed text-cream-dim` lead 'A cookie modal is the first promise you make. A `role="dialog" aria-modal="true"` `.ticket relative w-full max-w-[560px] overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-white/10 shadow-dialog` card (the .ticket gradient linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(14,39,72,0.9), rgba(8,25,51,0.9))). Then a full-width amber divider: a `h-px w-full bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-amber/25 to-transparent`. BODY (`px-6 pb-6 pt-5 sm:px-7`): an `h3 text-[1rem] font-bold text-cream` 'Your privacy choices'; an `mt-2 text-[13.5px] leading-relaxed text-cream-dim` message 'We use cookies to keep the site secure, measure how it is used, and personalize content. Necessary cookies are always on. Choose which optional categories to allow, then save.' with a trailing amber-300 'Read our policy' link; then an `mt-5 space-y-3` stack of three category rows (next component). FOOTER: a `h-px w-full bg-white/8` rule, then a `flex flex-col gap-3 px-6 py-5 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between sm:px-7` bar — LEFT a grouped pair (`flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row`) of a `.btn-amber` 'Accept all' (rounded-xl px-5 py-2.5 text-[14px] font-bold shadow-pill) + a `.btn-ghost` 'Reject all' (rounded-xl px-5 py-2.5 text-[14px] font-semibold), RIGHT a bordered 'Save preferences' (rounded-xl border border-amber/40 bg-navy-800/70 px-5 py-2.5 text-[14px] font-bold text-cream, hover border-amber/70 + bg-navy-700/60).

A full-bleed `section#patterns border-y border-white/10 bg-navy-850`, inner `mx-auto max-w-6xl px-5 py-16 sm:px-8 sm:py-20`. A `max-w-2xl` intro: a 12px font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-amber-300 eyebrow 'The system', an `mt-3 text-[1.9rem] sm:text-[2.3rem] font-extrabold tracking-tight text-cream` H2 'One palette, every overlay.', and a cream-dim lead 'Consent is the start. The same navy-and-amber language scales to every interrupt your product needs.' Then an `mt-10 grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4` of four `group rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-navy-800/50 p-5` cards (hover border-amber/35 + bg-navy-800). Each card = a 44px (h-11 w-11) rounded-xl bg-amber/12 icon tile holding an amber Phosphor icon (22px) + an `mt-4 text-[15px] font-bold text-cream` title + an `mt-1.5 text-[13px] leading-relaxed text-cream-dim` body. Cards: (1) ph:cookie-fill 'Consent' 'Granular toggles, plain language, two clear exits.'; (2) ph:warning-circle-fill 'Confirm' 'Destructive actions with a deliberate primary action.'; (3) ph:sign-in-fill 'Auth' 'Sign-in and paywall sheets that keep the flow.'; (4) ph:bell-ringing-fill 'Notice' 'Quiet announcements that never block the work.'

special_ui_components.prompt: The signature component: a `role="dialog" aria-modal="true"` `.ticket max-w-[560px] rounded-2xl border border-white/10 shadow-dialog` card presented as the live hero centerpiece (floated on a soft `absolute -inset-3 bg-amber/10 blur-2xl` glow, not on a blank artboard). It maps to four zones: a header (amber cookie title + bordered close button) over an amber gradient divider; an honest two-sentence message with a 'Read our policy' amber-300 link; a stack of three category rows (necessary locked-on, analytics + marketing toggles defaulting off); and a balanced footer where Accept all (amber) and Reject all (ghost) share equal weight on the left while a bordered Save preferences anchors the right. The whole component is the anti-dark-pattern thesis: amber is reserved, reject is as easy as accept, and cream-on-navy keeps it legible.

A 58x32px rounded-full pill switch with a 24px knob (top:4px) that slides via a .25s cubic-bezier transition, in three states: `.toggle-locked` (track #2a3f64 + inset amber/35 ring, knob at left:30px in amber #f0b429 holding a navy-900 ph:check-bold) for the always-on 'Strictly necessary' row; `.toggle-on` (track amber #f0b429 + inset amber/60 ring, knob at left:30px in navy-900 #081933 holding a navy-900 ph:check-bold) for an active category; `.toggle-off` (track #1c2f50 + inset cream/12 ring, knob at left:4px in cream #f4ecd8 holding a navy-700 ph:x-bold) for an opted-out category. Each carries role="switch" + aria-checked (or aria-label='Always on' for the locked variant).

A `.cat-row flex items-center gap-4 rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-navy-800/60 px-4 py-3.5` row (hover border-amber/35 + bg rgba(20,42,80,0.65)) used three-up inside the dialog body. Layout: a 28px (h-7 w-7) rounded-full bg-white/5 expander button with a cream-dim `.chev` ph:caret-down-bold (14px) on the left, a min-w-0 flex-1 column with a 14.5px font-bold cream title + a 12px cream-dim description, and a flex-none pill toggle on the right. Rows: 'Strictly necessary' (locked-on, 'Sessions, security, load balancing. Always active.'), 'Analytics' (off, 'Anonymous usage to help us improve the canvas.'), 'Marketing' (off, 'Personalized offers and remarketing pixels.').

The atmospheric backdrop reused on the hero and CTA bands: `.aurora` = three layered radials (radial-gradient(820px 520px at 78% -8%, rgba(240,180,41,0.16), transparent 60%) amber top-right, radial-gradient(900px 640px at 8% 18%, rgba(42,90,166,0.30), transparent 62%) blue upper-left, radial-gradient(1100px 800px at 50% 120%, rgba(22,53,98,0.40), transparent 60%) navy bottom) over the navy-900 body. Over it, `.grid-faint` = two 1px linear-gradients of rgba(240,236,216,0.035) at background-size 64px 64px, masked by radial-gradient(circle at 50% 30%, #000 0%, transparent 78%) so the grid fades to nothing at the edges. The amber-tinted glow `absolute -inset-3 rounded-[28px] bg-amber/10 blur-2xl` sits behind the dialog.

A faux terminal card in the CTA band: an `mx-auto max-w-2xl rounded-2xl border border-white/12 bg-navy-900/70 p-1.5 shadow-dialog backdrop-blur` wrapper with a top bar (border-b border-white/10 px-4 py-2.5) showing an amber ph:terminal-window-fill + a 12px font-semibold cream-dim 'prompt.txt' label on the left and an amber Copy pill (rounded-md bg-amber px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-bold text-navy-900 + ph:copy-fill) on the right, over a `px-4 py-4 font-mono text-[13px] leading-relaxed text-cream-soft` paragraph that states the generate prompt and highlights the navy #0b1f3a + amber #f0b429 hexes inline in amber-300.

structured.special_notes: Single Google Font: Inter (weights 400/500/600/700/800/900) as the only family (font-sans) — headlines extrabold/black (800-900) with tight tracking, body in cream-dim. Icons are Phosphor via Iconify (ph:shield-check-fill, ph:cookie-fill, ph:x-bold, ph:check-bold, ph:caret-down-bold, ph:magic-wand-fill, ph:check-circle-fill, ph:warning-circle-fill, ph:sign-in-fill, ph:bell-ringing-fill, ph:scales-fill, ph:eye-fill, ph:device-mobile-fill, ph:terminal-window-fill, ph:copy-fill, ph:rocket-launch-fill). EXACT tokens — navy 900 #081933, 850 #0b1f3a, 800 #0e2748, 700 #163562, 600 #1f4684, 500 #2a5aa6; cream DEFAULT #f4ecd8, soft #e8dec6, dim #c8bfa6; amber DEFAULT #f0b429, 600 #d99a12, 300 #f7cf6b. THE CORE DISCIPLINE (the point of this item): amber is RESERVED — it appears only on the brand mark, the primary CTA, the locked-on/active toggle, eyebrow chips, the header divider glow, and link text — so it always reads as a real, reversible choice and never as a manipulative default; cream-on-navy carries all text at WCAG-AA contrast; and Accept all / Reject all get equal weight (anti-dark-pattern). Radii: rounded-lg/xl on tiles + buttons, rounded-2xl on cards + the dialog. Shadows: shadow-dialog 0 40px 90px -20px rgba(3,10,24,0.75) + 0 0 0 1px rgba(240,180,41,0.10); shadow-pill 0 14px 30px -12px rgba(240,180,41,0.55). Effects: the layered .aurora hero/CTA backdrop + a masked .grid-faint overlay; an amber/10 blur glow behind the dialog; a frosted sticky nav (navy-900/80 + backdrop-blur-xl). Toggle states: .toggle-locked (#2a3f64 track, amber knob right), .toggle-on (amber track, navy knob right), .toggle-off (#1c2f50 track, cream knob left), each a 58x32 pill with a .25s knob slide. Motion: a .fade-up keyframe on hero columns (opacity 0 + translateY(16px) -> 1/0 over .7s), smooth .2-.25s transitions on toggles + .cat-row + card hovers. Layout: a sticky top-0 z-50 frosted nav over full-bleed bands on a shared max-w-6xl mx-auto px-5 sm:px-8 container (aurora two-column hero with the dialog centerpiece, navy-850 4-up patterns band, navy-900 anatomy band with a numbered list + mini callout dialog, navy-850 3-up trust band, aurora CTA band with a prompt.txt card, navy-900 footer). Responsive reflow: the hero + anatomy two-column grids collapse to one column, the nav center links hide (md:flex) and 'Copy prompt' hides (sm:block), the patterns grid steps sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 and trust md:grid-cols-3, the dialog footer stacks (sm:flex-row -> column) with Accept/Reject grouped, and the footer goes column. Accessibility intent: role="dialog" aria-modal on the card, role="switch" + aria-checked on the toggles, AA cream-on-navy contrast, and a balanced (non-dark-pattern) footer.
